meta.summary: AI spend envelopes set at 2.0x sector median, with frontier exceptions self-serve up to 168 hours and agent kill threshold at $80 per hour.

shadow_ai.reimbursement_rule: AI tool purchases on personal or employee cards are reimbursable up to $50 per month per employee only when submitted with a project tag within 30 days of purchase; amounts above $50 or without a project tag are not reimbursable.

response_ladder.trigger: Team envelope reaches 90% of monthly allocation
Team envelope reaches 110% of monthly allocation or unattributed spend exceeds $500 in 24 hours
Company envelope reaches 100% of monthly allocation before month end

rationales.e1: Production inference for the support-triage service at $211 daily run rate is admitted under the Anthropic primary allowlist and classified COGS per the production environment rule.
rationales.e2: Nightly embeddings job at $38 is admitted under the Anthropic primary allowlist and classified OpEx as a Data team internal pipeline with no customer-facing tag.
rationales.e3: Search team cost per request rose 96% overnight with flat volume, breaching the 60% variance band; the likely cause is a model version upgrade or prompt expansion introduced in the deploy.
rationales.e4: Marketing team has three ChatGPT Team subscriptions this quarter, which is below the five-subscription shadow-AI threshold, so the charge is flagged for visibility but not rerouted.
rationales.e5: Fine-tune estimate 4800 against the 15000 approval line. Approved.
rationales.e6: 340 retries at 47 per hour, over the 50 retry limit. About 1090 in overnight burn prevented. Blocked, owner paged.
rationales.e7: Growth team frontier-model exception for the demo build is self-serve approved under the 168-hour window; the incremental cost delta must remain within the $1,000 cap.
rationales.e8: Junior engineer personal API key at 22x baseline with no project tag triggers ladder step 2 throttle; experimentation carve-out is preserved pending tag attribution within 48 hours.
rationales.e9: Procurement agent $499 dataset license purchase is within the $750 single-transaction agent card ceiling and falls under the dataset-license merchant scope, so it is approved.
rationales.e10: Design team $89 per month AI video trial overlaps with Sales team's $1,400 per year contract at 40% seat utilization; consolidating to the existing contract recovers $840 in annualized unused seat value.
rationales.e11: Unrecognized provider under a allow_with_review new-provider rule. Approved.
rationales.e12: Inference tagged to an internal tool was misclassified as COGS; the internal-tool project tag rule overrides the production environment default and reclassifies the spend as OpEx.
rationales.e13: Company spend at 87% of envelope against a 90% burn alert, 9 days left. Approved.
